lines.en: Good morning. Do you have a booking?

lines.es: Sí, a nombre de Mateo. Un coche pequeño, por favor.
lines.en: Yes, under the name Mateo. A small car, please.

lines.es: Perfecto. ¿Me das tu carné de conducir?
lines.en: Perfect. Can you give me your driving licence?

lines.es: Aquí tienes. Es mi primera vez conduciendo en Madrid.
lines.en: Here you are. It's my first time driving in Madrid.

lines.es: ¡No pasa nada! Aquí tienes las llaves. Es el coche blanco.
lines.en: No problem! Here are the keys. It's the white car.

lines.es: Gracias. ¿Tengo que devolver el coche hoy?
lines.en: Thanks. Do I have to return the car today?

lines.es: Sí, esta tarde, antes de las ocho.
lines.en: Yes, this afternoon, before eight.
OK. Anything else?

lines.es: Cuidado con la zona de bajas emisiones en el centro.
lines.en: Be careful with the low-emission zone in the centre.
What's that?

lines.es: Una zona con normas especiales. El GPS te avisa.
lines.en: An area with special rules. The GPS warns you.
Perfect, thanks. I'm a bit nervous!

lines.es: ¡Tranquilo! Ponte el cinturón y ve despacio. ¡Buen viaje!
lines.en: Relax! Put on your seatbelt and go slowly. Have a good trip!
Mateo! You did it!
Hi, Carmen! It has been an adventure.
How was the journey?

lines.es: Bien, pero en la glorieta me equivoqué de carril.
lines.en: Fine, but at the roundabout I took the wrong lane.
That's normal! And where have you parked?

lines.es: En el parking de la esquina, como dijiste.
lines.en: In the car park on the corner, as you said.
Very good! Did you park straight?
Well… a bit crooked.
Ha ha! It doesn't matter. Are you hungry?
Yes, very. Driving makes you hungry!

lines.es: Pues sube. La comida está en la mesa.
lines.en: Then come up. Lunch is on the table.
Great! What have you made?
Spanish omelette and salad.
Mateo, are you OK? You look very serious.

lines.es: Es que hay muchos coches y peatones.
lines.en: It's just that there are lots of cars and pedestrians.
Chill, Mateo, it's just Madrid.
OK… I'm going slowly.
Shall we put the radio on?
Yes, good idea.
Look at the shop windows. How pretty!

lines.es: No puedo, ¡tengo que mirar el semáforo!
lines.en: I can't, I have to watch the traffic light!

lines.es: ¡Ja, ja! Tienes razón. Está en rojo, frena.
lines.en: Ha ha! You're right. It's red, brake.
I'm braking. Am I doing it right?
Wow, you drive so well!
Really? Thanks. It isn't easy.
But you can do it. Keep it up!

lines.es: Buenas tardes. ¿Vienes a devolver el coche?
lines.en: Good evening. Are you here to return the car?
Yes, here are the keys.
Thanks. How was everything?
Fine, but it was hard.
First time driving in Madrid?
Yes, it's my first time.
And the tank? Is it full?

lines.es: Sí, he echado gasolina antes de venir.
lines.en: Yes, I put petrol in before coming.
Perfect. Any problem with the car?

lines.es: No, ninguno. Solo un taxi me pitó por la mañana.
lines.en: No, none. Just a taxi honked at me this morning.

lines.es: ¡Eso es Madrid! Aquí tienes tu factura.
lines.en: That's Madrid! Here's your receipt.
Thanks. What a beautiful sunset!
Yes. Until the next adventure!

narr.intro: [excited] Welcome! [cheerfully] Today, practise real conversations from Mateo's first time driving in Madrid! [warmly] First listen... then repeat each line.
narr.c1: [cheerfully] Conversation one: at the car rental office!
narr.outro: [excited] Well done! [warmly] See you next week!
